Episode 256. Morganiel (2)
It is the domain of Morganiel; that calm voice contained all the suffering of the Black Sea expedition that had continued for the past several decades.
The harsh years that even Chiron and his most loyal knights had felt as endlessly severe were finally, almost, passing by. With only Morganiel, the last remaining king of the Black Sea, left.
That was why Chiron did not show a pleased expression even after seeing the troops and fleet led by his grown children.
“We are in the midst of battle, 1st Flagbearer. Compose your stance and focus on the enemy.”
At his cold and chilly tone, as if he were going through his demonic transformation, Luna immediately corrected her attitude.

As he had said, this place was a battlefield. Even if almost all the strongest warriors in the world had gathered, the Black Sea was a land where one must never let down their guard. Naturally, Chiron was not a 'father' right now, but the 'Patriarch.'
“My apologies, Patriarch. I will correct myself.”

“Forces other than the expeditionary force will maintain the command of the Young Patriarch, Jin Runcandel. What is pouring down in this domain is the energy of Morganiel. Be mindful of it seeping into your body, into your inner self. It would be best for those other than the Genesis Knights not to come outside the ships until the snow stops.”
Jin, Vahn, and Murakan disembarked from their respective ships and faced Chiron.
'If it weren't for my sister, I would have gotten an earful too.'

Jin only offered a sword salute to Chiron and raised his senses without a word. The Genesis Knights who followed Luna out took their positions naturally, as if they had just been carrying out missions and fighting with Chiron yesterday.
They could catch up as much as they wanted after they had finished off Morganiel.
The other members of the expeditionary force were not visible. However, the Genesis Knights could feel that they were scattered and tracking Morganiel.
'She realized we were coming and began to flee, Morganiel. Reading the movements of the expeditionary force members, it hasn't been long...'
It was faint.
The Genesis Knights, who had begun to advance through Morganiel's domain, noticed that her energy was extremely faint and dim.

It was like air. Something whose existence you could only know if you were conscious of it. The energy of Morganiel, which was falling like snow, had to be consciously pushed away at every moment for that reason.
Morganiel was exuding an energy that was fundamentally different from the other five kings of the Black Sea that the coalition and the expeditionary force had faced until now.
Not great, not threatening, not dark.
But because of that, it was even more unsettling.
“The energy that this Morganiel thing has... it feels somewhat similar to the kid's Eternal Flame.”
Vahn nodded at Murakan's assessment. The pure white energy that was falling gently disappeared quietly when it touched the body, making it impossible to tell if it was melting or seeping in.
The reason Chiron had been sitting in a formal meditative posture until the coalition fleet arrived was to clear out the energy of Morganiel that had seeped into his body and mind.

“The fleet will advance with Lafrarosa at the head, but be careful not to get ahead of the Genesis Knights. Focus on encirclement and cutting off her retreat route rather than on attacking. Also, firing is absolutely forbidden until my order is given.”
The fleet changed its formation at Jin's command.
For a while, a surprisingly quiet advance continued. Moving, brushing off Morganiel's snow, and moving again.
As time went on, the scenery changed little by little. Morganiel's pure white snowfield at some point turned ashen, and the field of vision became extremely narrow, as if a thick fog had settled.
It was to the extent that even the Genesis Knights could not distinguish a person five steps in front of them.

It was impossible to read their energy or to distinguish them through their footsteps and breathing. Sensory disturbance; it wasn't the first time they had faced an enemy that used such an ability, but this one was characterized by being more meticulous and natural.
However, it could not be a threat to the Genesis Knights.
In some ways, it was an obvious trick. If the Genesis Knights' attention was dispersed due to the disturbed senses, the possibility of them being exposed to Morganiel's energy would increase.
“Morganiel. In any case, only you are left now. How about you just accept the sword and be at ease.”
Hwoooong...!
For the first time, Chiron slowly cut through the ashen snowstorm with his sword. At that, Morganiel's form, which had been hidden between the fog, was revealed for a moment.
A form like a person sculpted from plaster, and on her face and all over her body, cracks were spreading like on a damaged statue.
They were the traces left from being struck by Chiron's sword before.
To be precise, every time Chiron had dealt a blow to the 'Black Sea' until now, Morganiel's body had taken damage. This was the first time even Chiron had seen Morganiel at such a close distance.
Morganiel could no longer hide her body in the fog.

The coalition's Genesis Knights were already aiming their swords at her from all directions. The members of the expeditionary force, including Khan, also revealed themselves at the location where the Genesis Knights had newly cleared the fog, and they were all in a gaunt and emaciated state. It was the result of Morganiel's energy continuously seeping into them.
'This is... the last remaining king of the Black Sea.'
The largest fragment of the Origin Stone.
Jin felt as if the attributes of various transcendent beings were dwelling within the fated enemy of Chiron, whom he was finally facing.
In reality, her appearance was so similar to Malugia that they could have been siblings, and the divine energy spread in all directions showed characteristics similar to the Eternal Flame.

From the sword she held in her hand, for some reason, he saw Vahn; in her deep and emotionless eyes, he saw the Chiron from before his demonic transformation; and on her fingernails, which were the only thing that glistened black amidst all the gray, he saw the Evil God.
Furthermore, it seemed as if the feelings of past formidable enemies like Paellito, Shimat, and Zito, as well as Luna and Murakan, were also faintly emanating from somewhere on Morganiel.
'Is it an illusion? No. This is... what in the world is this?'
It wasn't just Jin who was feeling this. Everyone except for Chiron was flinching before the uncomfortable feeling.
Only Chiron was focused entirely on the wounds on her body.
The wounds carved by cutting away at the Black Sea his entire life, from his youth until now. It was no exaggeration to say that they symbolized Chiron's entire life.
“I appeared in this world to cut you down.”
Chiron's voice was trembling slightly.
It was, truly, elation. It was the first time he had felt such a fulfilling emotion before taking an enemy's life.
Morganiel did not answer and fixed her gaze on Chiron. Even though the Genesis Knights had perfectly surrounded Morganiel, they were not pushing their swords in.

It was because the snow had stopped. Even though they had been consciously dealing with it the whole time, they could feel the energy of Morganiel heavily accumulated throughout their bodies and spirits.
It could be said to be the price one had to pay to face Morganiel at such a close distance. To be a Genesis Knight was the minimum qualification to pay that price.
'A trap that is impossible not to fall into.'
Long-range combat was impossible as it would cause problems with tracking, and close-range combat had to be started in a state of being eroded by Morganiel.

In that sense, Morganiel had already rendered one of the weapons of those who had come to find her useless. The Golden Fleet, including the flying fortress Lafrarosa, could not bombard Morganiel in a situation like this.

Because the eroded Genesis Knights could not produce their usual power. Aura, magic, lightning, spiritual energy. The energy of Morganiel that had penetrated the Genesis Knights was blocking most of all that power.
A trained body and will.
The only abilities the Genesis Knights could use to attack Morganiel were those two. She had blocked all the energies of the five Genesis Knights.
The outrageous power that parted mountains and lands, skies and seas.
They had to fight as if such a power had never existed in this world in the first place. Both the Genesis Knights and Morganiel herself.
If the fleet were to pour down a bombardment in this state, the Genesis Knights too would be blown apart as helplessly as ordinary humans.
Siiik, Chiron smiled and took another step towards Morganiel.

And at that moment, Morganiel's blade flew towards Chiron's neck first. Chiron struck that blade away and, in reverse, tried to cut Morganiel's waist, and the Genesis Knights who had her rear also extended their swords at almost the same time.
Morganiel could not dodge all those blades. While Barisada and the ashen sword were entangled, the blades of Jin, Luna, and Vahn pierced and grazed her back.
New cracks appeared on her stone-like body, and from those gaps, crimson blood, as if from a person, spurted out.

Before even 10 seconds had passed, Morganiel had turned into a statue stained with blood, leaving a sticky trail of blood every time she moved. If her body had been like a normal human's like the Genesis Knights, the fight would have already been over at this point.
Cheong, Kigigik!

Every time the swords of the Genesis Knights and the claws of Murakan touched her, blood and stone flew from Morganiel. Chiron, who was continuously facing her head-on, was covered in the most blood and fragments.
[Death comes for everyone equally, Chiron Runcandel.]
Morganiel's sword pierced Chiron's shoulder. However, the wound was not very deep, and the moment Morganiel tried to retrieve her blade, Chiron cut her wrist.
Takak, Jjeolgeureong...!
As if struck by a blunt weapon, not a sword, Morganiel's wrist shattered and fell to the ground. The sword she was holding shattered like glass, leaving sharp fragments on the floor.

It was the moment the battle ended. Chiron wiped the blood and fragments of Morganiel from his face and looked down at her, and the Genesis Knights forced her to her knees as they caught their breath.
“Are those the only words you have to leave, Morganiel.”
Suddenly, a vibration was beginning.
Just as a wound had appeared on Morganiel every time Chiron had cut the Black Sea until now, this time, the entire Black Sea was reacting to Morganiel's death.

Morganiel slowly raised her head and met Chiron's eyes. Even as death approached, the Genesis Knights could still see the forms of various transcendent beings in her. In fact, it was to the point where they felt as if they were standing out even more vividly than before, like a nightmare.
[The reason I have decided to die by your hand now is merely to not violate that truth. I pray that victory is before you, my old friend.]
